main.description: A shared step at its latest version, from the dev.knotless.release records of its package, `@step/<name>`: what it does, takes and asks for, each version published, and the public repositories whose default branch pins it in `.knotless/uses.lock`. No authentication; responses are not personalized.

errors.description: No such repository, no step of that name in it, or no index on this appview.
errors.name: NotFound

repo.description: The step's repository, by its dev.knotless.repo record. Its authority may be a handle.

description: One shared step a repository publishes.
